name: keepxclean
description: KeepXClean - High signal-to-noise ratio filter extension for X (Twitter) powered by Cloudflare crowd-sourced blocklist (keepxclean.com)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @keepxclean/shared build && pnpm --filter @keepxclean/extension build && pnpm --filter @keepxclean/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @keepxclean/shared test && pnpm --filter @keepxclean/extension test && pnpm --filter @keepxclean/server test && pnpm --filter @keepxclean/web test
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --filter @keepxclean/web build && pnpm --filter @keepxclean/web exec wrangler deploy
